'''Noah Penda''' (born 7 January 2005) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for [[Le Mans Sarthe Basket]] of the [[LNB Élite]]. He previously played for [[JA Vichy Basket|JA Vichy-Clermont]].

==Early life==
Penda was born on 7 January 2005.<ref name="auto5">{{Cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Noah-Penda/Summary/165599|publisher=[[RealGM]]|title=Noah Penda}}</ref> He was born in [[Paris]] and grew up in [[Bondy]].<ref name="auto2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.msb.fr/index.php/component/content/article/42-equipes/pros/actualite/6076-au-msb-noah-penda-veut-creer-un-lien-special-avec-le-public|website=msb.fr|language=French|title=Au MSB, Noah Penda veut "créer un lien spécial avec le public"|trans-title=At MSB, Noah Penda wants to "create a special bond with the public"|date=22 June 2024}}</ref> He played several sports when young, including [[Association football|football]], [[judo]], [[Swimming (sport)|swimming]] and [[tennis]], before trying out [[basketball]].<ref name="auto2"/> He started playing basketball as a youth for the club BC Fontenay.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.basketidf.com/les-premieres-medailles-de-lete/|website=basketidf.com|language=French|title=Les premières médailles de l’été|date=18 July 2022|trans-title=The first medals of the summer}}</ref> He later was a member of the clubs Villemomble and [[Levallois Sporting Club Basket|Levallois]].<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/basket/le-mans/basket-elite-le-msb-engage-noah-penda-le-meilleur-jeune-de-pro-b-06599358-142d-11ef-a482-9d66515b057a|website=[[Ouest-France]]|language=French|title=Basket. Élite : le MSB engage Noah Penda, le meilleur jeune de Pro B |date=17 May 2024|author=Jean, Bertrand|trans-title=Basketball. Elite: MSB hires Noah Penda, the best young player in Pro B}}</ref> He averaged 19.5 points in 11 games for the Levallois U15 squad in the 2019–20 season before joining [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball]] for the following season.<ref name="auto4">{{Cite web|url=https://mr-stats.frenchbasketballscouting.fr/joueur/penda-noah-8803|website=mr-stats.frenchbasketballscouting.fr|language=French|trans-title=All seasons of the player PENDA Noah|title=Toutes les saisons du joueur PENDA Noah}}</ref> He played 13 games for Centre in the [[Nationale Masculine 1]], the third-tier of French basketball, during the 2020–21 season, averaging 2.9 points.<ref name="auto4"/> He remained with the team for the following season and averaged 10.6 points.<ref name="auto4"/>
==Professional career==
===JA Vichy-Clermont===
In June 2022, Penda signed a professional contract with [[JA Vichy Basket|JA Vichy-Clermont]] in the [[LNB Pro B]], the second-tier of French basketball.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ancien.ffbb.com/pole-france-basket/noah-penda-vichyclermont|website=ancien.ffbb.com|language=French|title=Noah Penda à Vichy/Clermont|author=Bosi, Kévin|date=9 June 2022|trans-title=Noah Penda to Vichy/Clermont}}</ref> He appeared in 37 games during the 2022–23 season, averaging 3.9 points.<ref name="auto5"/> The following season, he appeared in 37 games again and average 9.5 points and 5.9 rebounds, being selected second-team All-LNB Pro B by [[Eurobasket.com]] and the league's best young player.<ref name="auto"/><ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.eurobasket.com/France/news/876397/Noah-Penda-agreed-terms-with-Le-Mans|website=[[Eurobasket.com]]|title=Noah Penda agreed terms with Le Mans|date=17 June 2024|author=Patel, Arpita}}</ref>
===Le Mans Sarthe===
Penda signed with [[Le Mans Sarthe Basket]], in the [[LNB Élite]], France's top-tier, in June 2024.<ref name="auto1"/> He began seeing significant playing time as a starter despite being only 19 years old in his first season with the team.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/noah-penda-le-mans-strong-start-draft-france|website=[[Sports Illustrated]]|title=Noah Penda Is Playing a Big Role for Le Mans|date=November 12, 2024|author=Bernucca, Andrew}}</ref> He was an [[LNB All-Star Game|LNB All-Star]] and participated in the league's Young Star Game in January, where he was named [[most valuable player]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Young-star-game-noah-penda-mvp-devant-un-parterre-de-scouts-nba/1534074|newspaper=[[L'Équipe]]|language=French|title=Young Star Game : Noah Penda MVP devant un parterre de scouts NBA|date=21 January 2025|author=Colombani, Xavier|trans-title=Young Star Game: Noah Penda MVP in front of an audience of NBA scouts}}</ref> Following his breakout year, Penda was named the [[LNB Pro A Best Young Player]], after averaging 10.3 points, 5.3 rebounds and 2.8 assists over the season.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2025-05-17 |title=Trophées LNB 2025 : les lauréats en Betclic ELITE |url=https://www.lnb.fr/elite/trophees-lnb-2025-les-laureats-en-betclic-elite/ |access-date=2025-05-27 |website=Betclic ELITE |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Proballers |title=Noah Penda, Basketball Player, Stats, Height, Age |url=https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/212649/noah-penda |access-date=2025-05-31 |website=Proballers |language=en}}</ref>

Penda has been viewed as a potential prospect for the [[2025 NBA draft]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-france-noah-penda|website=[[Sports Illustrated]]|title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: France's Noah Penda|date=30 October 2024}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/nba-draft-noah-penda-should-be-in-first-round-pick-consideration|website=[[Sports Illustrated]]|title=NBA Draft: Noah Penda Should be in First-Round Pick Consideration|date=13 November 2024|author=Kumpatla, Maurya}}</ref>
==International career==
Penda competed for France at the [[2022 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup]], averaging 7.5 points in six games played.<ref name="auto3">{{Cite web|url=https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/212649/noah-penda|website=Proballers.com|title=Noah Penda}}</ref> He later participated in the [[2023 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup]], helping France place second.<ref name="auto"/> He represented France at the [[2024 FIBA U20 EuroBasket]] tournament, where he averaged 11.7 points in seven games and won the championship.<ref name="auto3"/> In the quarterfinals of the tournament, with France down by one point against Spain, he made a game-winning [[buzzer beater]] shot to win 74–72.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Noah-penda-envoie-la-france-en-demi-finales-de-l-euro-u20-apres-un-shoot-au-buzzer-face-a-l-espagne/1483387|newspaper=[[L'Équipe]]|language=French|title=Noah Penda envoie la France en demi-finales de l'Euro U20 après un shoot au buzzer face à l'Espagne|trans-title=Noah Penda sends France into Euro U20 semi-finals after buzzer-beating shot against Spain|date=18 July 2024}}</ref>
